issue_context.title: more than one add index ddl jobs triggered with ingest type
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

triggered add index ddl for 64 tables in very short time 

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
only one ddl will use ingest type to add index 

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

review_comments: if return err，can will still run add index？Or when there is err for lightning mode, can we all use txnMerge?

> if return err，can will still run add index？

No. Users should check their configuration and fix the issue, or turn off `tidb_ddl_enable_fast_reorg`.

> Or when there is err for lightning mode, can we all use txnMerge?

If something goes wrong halfway through the execution, it will fallback to txn-merge mode.
Even with fast ddl off，Can we also use txnMerge way？
If there is a bug with txn-merge mode, there is no way to work around it.
Why not use txn mode? currently txn mode is better than txnMerge, because there is no need for merge tmp index.
But `txn-merge` has little impact on the foreground workload.
If there is any problem with the import order, the build will fail.
